name: TTS 朗读
description: 用云端语音合成朗读消息（小米 MiMo 或 Azure）：点消息旁边的喇叭，读你说的话或 agent 的回复。长回复一段一段合成，第一句很快就开始读。

settings.title: 服务商
settings.description: 换了服务商，下面跟着换成它的设置。

settings.title: 朗读风格
settings.default: 自然、亲切、利落，不要播音腔，语速中等偏快，句与句之间停顿短一点
settings.description: 一句话说想要的语气，随文字一起发给模型。清空就是模型默认的读法。

settings.title: 接口地址
settings.description: 走代理 / 中转时改这里。

settings.title: Key
settings.description: Azure 门户里语音（Speech）资源的「密钥和终结点」页，KEY 1 或 KEY 2。

settings.title: 区域
settings.description: 同一页的「位置/区域」，如 eastasia、southeastasia、eastus。

settings.title: 音色
settings.description: 语音名，如 zh-CN-XiaoxiaoMultilingualNeural、zh-CN-YunxiNeural、en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural。完整列表见 Azure 的语音库（Voice Gallery）。

settings.title: 语速
settings.description: 相对正常语速快多少，0 是正常，负数变慢。

settings.title: 读哪些
settings.description: agent 的回复：只读最后一段（干完活的总结），跳过过程中说的话；或者全读。只读最后一段时，读着读着点前面的某段，也会从那段接着读下去。你发的消息总是全读。

settings.title: 试听
settings.label: 播放
settings.description: 用上面的设置读一句，听听对不对。

en.name: TTS Read Aloud
en.description: Reads messages aloud with cloud speech synthesis (Xiaomi MiMo or Azure): tap the speaker beside a message. Long replies are synthesized piece by piece, so reading starts right away.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Switch it and the settings below switch to its own.

preview.title: Preview
preview.label: Play
preview.description: Reads a sentence with the settings above, to check they work.

style.title: Style
style.description: The tone you want, in a sentence, sent to the model with the text. Empty: the model's own reading.

baseURL.title: API address
baseURL.description: Change it to go through a proxy.

azureKey.description: KEY 1 or KEY 2 on the "Keys and Endpoint" page of your Speech resource in the Azure portal.

azureRegion.title: Region
azureRegion.description: The Location/Region on the same page, e.g. eastasia, southeastasia, eastus.

azureVoice.title: Voice
azureVoice.description: A voice name, e.g. en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural, zh-CN-XiaoxiaoMultilingualNeural. Full list: Azure's Voice Gallery.

azureRate.title: Speed
azureRate.description: How much faster than normal; 0 is normal, negative is slower.

scope.title: What to read
scope.description: For an agent's reply: only its last part (the summary once the work is done), skipping what it said along the way; or all of it. Reading the last part, a tap on an earlier paragraph still jumps there and reads on. Your own messages are always read whole.
